senses.gloss: Gādheyī (“the daughter of Gādhi”) = Satyavatī: XIII, 242.

Gādhi or Gādhin, a king of Kānyakubja, the son of Kuśika and the father of Viśvāmitra and Satyavatī. § 223 (Vāsishṭha): I, 175, 6651 (Kānyakubje mahān āsīt pārthivo, Bharatarshabha | Gādhīti viśruto loke Kuśikasyātmasambhavaḥ, father of Viśvāmitra).--§ 395 (Jamadagni): III, 115, 10145 (ºīti viśrutaḥ, went to the woods), 10146 (ºiḥ, Ṛcīka married his daughter [Satyavatī], having given 1,000 horses as a dowry).--§ 565 (Gālavac.): V, 119, 4005 (ºeḥ Satyavatīṃ sutāṃ, repetition from § 395).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 315 (ºeḥ).--§ 615n (Viśvāmitra): IX, 40, 2296 (ºiḥ; father of Viśvāmitra), 2299 (do.), 2300 (do., having installed Viśvāmitra on the throne, G. went to heaven).--§ 638b (Rāmopākhyāna): XII, 49, 1720 (Gādhir nāmābhavat putraḥ Kauśikaḥ Pākaśāsanaḥ, Indra was born as G.), 1721 (ºiḥ, Satyavatī was given in marriage to Ṛcīka, cf. § 395), 1722 (ºeḥ), 1727 (ºiḥ), 1745 (do., birth of Viśvāmitra).--§ 721b (Viśvāmitrop.): XIII, 4, 205 (Kuśikasyātmajaḥ…Gºir nāma), 208 (ºiḥ), (211) (do.); 217 (ºaye), 218 (ºiḥ, Satyavatī was given in marriage to Ṛcīka, who had given 1,000 horses as a dowry), 246 (ºbhāryā, birth of Viśvāmitra).--§ 745c (Cyavana-Kuśikasaṃv.): XIII, 56, 2914 (ºer duhitaraṃ, i.e. Satyavatī), 2915 (Viśvāmitraṃ…Gºeḥ putraṃ). Cf. Kauśika.
Gādhija (“the son of Gādhi”) = Viśvāmitra: IX, 2306 (Vº), 2311, 2394.
Gādhinandana (“the son of Gādhi”) = Viśvāmitra: I, 6663.
Gādhisutā (“the daughter of Gādhi”) = Satyavatī: III, 10153.
